summary: A dating app contact moved the user to Telegram and developed a relationship before promising to send 3000 dollars while requiring Bitcoin payments for purported processing fees. The user sent more than 2000 dollars through Cash App and to Bitcoin addresses but received none of the promised funds.
user_mistake: sent repeated Bitcoin payments to a dating contact to release promised funds
prevention: Do not send crypto to receive promised money from an online romantic contact / Stop paying additional fees when promised funds have not arrived
